systems.name: 4.1 Ghost State & Abilities
systems.notes: On death, players become Ghosts. They can see the Mimic's true aura but cannot communicate directly with the living. They manipulate the environment to guide survivors.
tasks: Ghost transition: death animation → spectral form
Ghost vision: can see Mimic's true aura at all times
Ghost movement: free roam, pass through walls, no collision
Ghost abilities: slam doors, rattle chains, flicker lights

systems.name: 4.2 Environmental Interaction for Ghosts
systems.notes: Ghosts trigger environmental traps and hazards to slow or damage the Mimic. Use existing dungeon objects as ghost-interactable.
tasks: Ghosts can trigger traps (spike pits, falling rocks, poison gas)
Poltergeist actions: throw objects to create noise distractions
Haunt mechanic: possess a single object to create a persistent hazard
Cooldown on ghost abilities to prevent spam

systems.name: 4.3 Ghost Communication Restrictions
systems.notes: Ghosts cannot speak or text directly with the living. They must use environmental cues. Ghosts have their own private chat channel.
tasks: Isolate Ghost chat from living player chat
Environmental cue system: ghosts can trigger pre-set 'signals'
Ghosts can leave spectral marks visible only to living with high Spirit affinity
